snippet.title: Monologin Trailer - VAINSANE Fridays #6
snippet.description:
VAINSANE Fridays #6 — Monologin 

A directionless night-shift worker clings to a dying MMORPG, a legendary White Unicorn mount, and the belief that old games are more "real" in this short psychological horror visual novel about escapism and being left behind.

Part of VAINSANE Fridays, where I release a new bite-sized horror game every other Friday. Released June, 2026.

Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4692700/Monologin/
